basis: Reed’s March 28 earnings release was the earliest verified communication to establish the decline explicitly for Q4 2023. Its GAAP statements of operations reported company-wide net sales of $11,693,000 for the three months ended December 31, 2023, versus $15,040,000 for the same quarter of 2022. Sales fell 22.25%, below the $14,288,000 cutoff.

coverage.detail: August 10, 2023, preceding earnings cycle. Reed’s forecast $48 million to $52 million in full-year 2023 net sales. Its second-half targets concerned profitability and cash flow. It gave no Q4 net-sales ceiling.

November 9 Q3 release. Full-year guidance of $45 million to $47 million less reported nine-month net sales of $33.018 million implied Q4 sales of $11.982 million to $13.982 million. Even the implied high end was below the cutoff, but Reed’s stated the forecast only for the year. Its Q4 sales commentary concerned delayed seasonal shipments.

On the November 10 public call, management repeated the annual range and said seasonal shipments had resumed in October. The CFO’s approximately $625,000 Q4 estimate concerned an inventory valuation adjustment affecting gross margin. Neither executive gave a quarterly net-sales figure.
The November investor presentation supplied retailer-specific sales, case volumes and distribution figures. It gave no company-wide Q4 net-sales forecast.
The December 15 Form 8-K reported annual-meeting voting results and contained no Q4 sales update.

February 13, 2024, financing announcement. The CEO expected a Q4 operating loss and positive modified EBITDA. The $3.8 million and $6 million financing figures did not measure sales. The preliminary-results language accompanied no Q4 net-sales estimate.
The March 4 Form 8-K disclosed CFO compensation and officer indemnification arrangements. It contained no Q4 sales update.
Reed’s March 19 call notice, reproduced from GlobeNewswire, scheduled the March 28 results call and said a release would precede it. The notice supplied no sales figure.

March 28 actuals. The issuer’s statements of operations show 11,693 and 15,040 in thousands in the Q4 2023 and Q4 2022 Net Sales columns. Both figures use the reported company-wide revenue line, including the effect of the 2023 trade-spend discount adjustment.

publication_date_evidence: Reed’s investor-relations page dates the results release March 28, 2024. The same release in SEC Exhibit 99.1 carries a March 28 Norwalk dateline and announces results for the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2023.
